_comment: Applied by scripts/apply-sources.sh after the APKs in golden-state.json. Capture cannot see in-app repos: they live in private app data. Do not put accounts or tokens in this file.

manual.why: The six extension APKs above are installed silently. The repo itself is one deep link, fired by apply-sources only with --with-intents, because it brings the app forward and the provision verify step presses HOME.

Plugins are private app data. The external plugins directory on the working TV was empty. cloudstreamrepo:// opens an add-repository dialog, so it is not safe to fire during an unattended run. The official repo is master/repo.json (builds/repo.json is 404). Both are seeded into CloudStream Household, and the installed plugins move with scripts/capture-app-settings.sh.

No add-repo intent. zangetsu:// is only anilist/mal/simkl auth, open, room, and pair. The nine installed providers are private app data; scripts/capture-app-settings.sh moves them (TorBox needs its key re-entered).

Private app data; add manually in Settings > Addons. OpenSubtitles v3, Torrentio, Comet and Flix-Streams Free were visible and enabled on 2026-10-30. Flix-Streams needs no account. Two Interstellar links returned HTTP 200 video/mkv; four Shawshank links returned HTTP 502. TV playback not verified. HdHub was installed on 2026-10-30; a sampled direct video link returned HTTP 206 on a PC, but TV playback has not been verified.

Settings > Addons requires manual entry; app data cannot be copied. On the source TV, Cinemeta, Torrentio, Comet, OpenSubtitles v3, MediaFusion, and Flix-Streams Free were visible on 2026-10-30. Flix-Streams returns HTTP links without an account; playback still needs testing. Flix-Streams HTTP tests on 2026-10-30: two Interstellar links returned HTTP 200 video/mkv, while four Shawshank links returned HTTP 502; TV playback not verified. HdHub was installed on 2026-10-30; a sampled direct video link returned HTTP 206 on a PC, but TV playback has not been verified.
Content plugin is built into the APK. Nothing to provision.
